historicalNuances.twoSignedOriginals: Zurich Z and Hessian K both exist, with additions in Z articles 7, 13 and 15.
historicalNuances.publishedPrintsNotEquated: 1529 VD16 W2117, W2118, W2119, W2108 are catalogued separate print editions. Their wording is not asserted equal to either signed manuscript.
historicalNuances.dateCaution: Signed agreement is conventionally dated 3 Oct 1529 by Zurich archival entry and text heading, while a Reformation 3.0 presentation states fair copies dated 4 Oct; do not treat exact preparation/signing day as verified by these summaries alone.
historicalNuances.laterEditions: 1531 Latin VD16 C4734 and German VD16 C4736 are separate language print records. 1540 Latin Variata C4713 is not the unidentified 1540 Gruber non-Variata copy.
historicalNuances.zurichAdditionsTextStatus: Official archive certifies the existence of three additions; thematic paraphrases of Art7/Art15 came from an unverified secondary hosted English transcript and are not textual-original proof.
